Coimbatore · At the foot of the Western Ghats

An estate in the foothills.

Ninety-six rooms and four garden suites wrapped around an infinity pool, twelve minutes from Coimbatore International. Two kitchens, two bars, and the Nilgiris turning blue at the edge of every evening.

96 Rooms & Suites 2 Restaurants · 2 Bars Pool · Spa · 220-pax Banquets Airport 12 min 30-second express check-in

Four categories, ninety-six keys

Rooms that hold the evening light

Every room carries the same handwoven linen, a desk worth sitting at, and glass from floor to ceiling. What changes is the floor, the light, and how much of the Ghats you wake up to.

Two kitchens, two bars

Dining & Bars

Breakfast for the 7am flight, a Kongunadu tasting menu at eight, and a lantern-lit deck that stays open long after the last meeting ends.

Rates & packages

Offers

Our house fills Monday to Thursday. Which is exactly why the weekend is the best value in Coimbatore — and why we built a package around it.

Friday – Sunday

The Long Weekend

Two nights in a Deluxe room, breakfast for two, a late 4pm checkout and ₹1,500 of credit at Nilgiri Deck. Built for the weekend you keep postponing.

Getting here

Billing & GST

Invoice register

Every checkout and every settled POS check lands here automatically with a sequential GST series — and the same day-book pushes to Tally each night in the production build.

Control

Approvals

Nothing here is decided by the person who asked for it — except the things the owner has said may be. The owner can act on any request at any level.

Requests

The escalation matrix

What may be self-approved, and what must go up

An issued invoice is never deleted. When the owner approves a cancellation the system raises a credit note against it, so the register still balances and the trail survives.Every decision is written to the audit log with who, when and why.
